text:
Substance Y is a pink solid.
When substance Y is heated gently it becomes a blue solid.
When the blue solid is cooled down it remains blue.
When water is added to the blue solid it becomes pink.
What is substance Y?
anhydrous cobalt(II) chloride
A
B
anhydrous copper(II) sulfate
hydrated cobalt(II) chloride
C
hydrated copper(II) sulfate
D
subject: Chemistry
